page.overview:
Who is Pamela Ford?

Pamela Ford is a Lasombra member of The Ravens, a politically motivated coven in the Sabbat. Driven by intense ambition, she secretly follows the Path of Evil Revelations in her bid to take over the pack.

Pamela was always a bright tomboy who excelled academically, graduating from college with honors. Her intelligence, ambition, and beauty easily landed her a good job with an information network, where she quickly secured a vice-presidency—though sex and treachery had more to do with her rapid climb than actual ability or dedication.

One night, while working late to catch up on reports, she received an unwelcome visitor. A beautiful woman in black informed Pamela that she had been selected for a once-in-a-lifetime position, recruiting her into the Sabbat. For her first mission, she was sent against a Giovanni accused of destroying a Sabbat Nosferatu. While the mission was successful, Pamela was the only recruit to return alive.

Since then, Pamela has set her sights on becoming the leader of The Ravens. To further this goal, she began building a network of contacts among the Sabbat across the city and region. One of these contacts clued her into a dark shortcut to power, leading Pamela to strike a deal with demonic forces and walk the Path of Evil Revelations.
